source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 23 (PDF 208-214), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Pharmacology) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define pharmacology. What does it include?
(Pharmacology ki definition likhein. Is mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pharmacology biology ki woh shakh hai jo dawaon aur zinda organisms par un ke asraat ka mutaala karti hai. Is mein dawaon ke zariye, khasiyat, banawat, ilaji istemal aur jism par asraat shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: It includes the study of the sources, properties, composition, therapeutic uses

blocks.prompt:
2 What are drugs? Name their sources.
(Drugs kya hain? In ke zariye batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Drugs woh kimiyai mawad hain jo bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaj ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh paudon, janwaron aur microorganisms jaise qudrati zariyon se milte hain ya laboratory mein banaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: or they may be synthesized in laboratories

blocks.prompt:
3 What are herbal medicines?
(Herbal medicines kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paudon se tayyar ki gayi dawaiyan herbal medicines ya phytotherapy kehlati hain. Yeh riwayati tareeqa-e-ilaj mein aam istemal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Medicines prepared from plants are commonly used in traditional systems of treatment

blocks.prompt:
4 Who works together during drug discovery and development, and why?
(Drug discovery aur development mein kaun mil kar kaam karte hain aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists, researchers aur regulatory idare poore amal mein mil kar kaam karte hain taa ke nayi dawaiyan insanon ke liye faidemand aur mehfooz hon; manzoori se pehle dawa ki safety, efficacy aur quality test hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: scientists, researchers, and regulatory authorities work together throughout this process

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between drug discovery and drug development.
(Drug discovery aur drug development mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Discovery dawa dhoondti hai; development use test aur tayyar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the process of testing and preparing the discovered drug for public use

rows: Kisi bimari ke liye nayi dawa dhoondne ka ibtidai marhala
Daryaft shuda dawa ko test kar ke awam ke liye tayyar karne ka amal
Marahil: target identification, target validation, lead compound identification, lead optimization
Marahil: preclinical research, clinical trials, FDA review, manufacturing aur marketing, post-marketing surveillance

blocks.prompt:
6 What is target identification in drug discovery?
(Drug discovery mein target identification kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists aik khaas molecule, maslan protein ya enzyme, pehchante hain jo bimari paida karne mein shamil ho. Yeh target is liye chuna jata hai ke dawa us par asar kar ke bimari ka ilaj kar sake.

book_ref.quote: This target is selected because it can be affected by a drug to treat the disease

blocks.prompt:
7 What is target validation?
(Target validation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Target validation mein researchers tasdeeq karte hain ke pehchana gaya target bimari ke amal mein ahem kirdar rakhta hai. Tajarbon se yaqeeni banaya jata hai ke us par asar karne se ilaji faida hoga.

book_ref.quote: Experiments are carried out to ensure that acting on the target can produce therapeutic effects

blocks.prompt:
8 What are lead compounds? How are they identified?
(Lead compounds kya hain? Inhein kaise pehchana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists hazaron qudrati ya masnooi compounds ki screening karte hain taa ke woh mawad milen jo target molecule se achhi tarah amal karen. Yeh umeed afza mawad lead compounds kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Scientists screen thousands of natural or synthetic compounds

blocks.prompt:
9 What is lead optimization?
(Lead optimization kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lead optimization woh marhala hai jis mein lead compounds ko badal kar un ka asar barhaya, zehreelapan kam kiya aur dawa jaisi khasiyat behtar ki jati hain.

book_ref.quote: and enhance the drug-like properties

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between in vitro and in vivo testing in preclinical research.
(Preclinical research mein in vitro aur in vivo testing ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono insani trials se pehle safety, toxicity aur efficacy naapne ke liye hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: to measure safety, toxicity, and efficacy before human trials

rows: Compounds cells ki culture mein test hote hain
Compounds janwaron mein test hote hain
Zinda jism se bahar
Zinda janwar ke jism mein

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between Phase 1 and Phase 3 of clinical trials.
(Clinical trials ke Phase 1 aur Phase 3 mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono insanon par clinical trials hain, magar group aur maqsad mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: Drugs are tested on humans to ensure safety

rows: 20-100 ka chhota group
1,000-3,000 ka bara trial
Sehatmand razakar
Mareez
Safety aur dose maloom karta hai
Efficacy ki tasdeeq aur muzir asraat ki nigrani karta hai

blocks.prompt:
12 What is the role of the FDA drug review in drug development?
(Drug development mein FDA drug review ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Regulatory idare (FDA ya EMA) clinical trials ka saara data bariki se jaanch kar dawa ko market mein aane se pehle manzoor ya rad karte hain.

book_ref.quote: to approve or reject the drugs before supply to market

blocks.prompt:
13 Why is post-marketing surveillance necessary?
(Post-marketing surveillance kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Market mein aane ke baad bhi dawa ki lambe arse ke asraat aur kam paye jane wale side effects ke liye musalsal nigrani hoti hai. Is se aabadi mein us ki musalsal hifazat yaqeeni banti hai.

book_ref.quote: to ensure ongoing safety in the population

blocks.prompt:
14 What are antibiotics? Name the four major classes of antibiotics.
(Antibiotics kya hain? In ki chaar bari qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Antibiotics woh dawaiyan hain jo bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki barhotri rok kar bacterial infection ka ilaj karti hain. In ki darja bandi amal ke tareeqe aur kimiyai banawat par hai; chaar bari qismein penicillin, tetracycline, fluoroquinolones aur sulfonamides hain.

book_ref.quote: The major four classes are

blocks.prompt:
15 Differentiate between bactericidal and bacteriostatic antibiotics.
(Bactericidal aur bacteriostatic antibiotics mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq bacteria par asar ka hai.

book_ref.quote: kills rather than just inhibits growth

rows: Bacteria ko maarti hain
Bacteria ko maare baghair un ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hain
Maslan penicillin (cell phatna), fluoroquinolones (DNA ki dono strands tootna)
Maslan tetracycline, sulfonamides
Bacteria dawa ke amal se mar jate hain
Ruke hue bacteria ko jism ka immune system khatam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
16 What is penicillin? Who discovered it?
(Penicillin kya hai? Ise kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin Penicillium fungi se hasil bactericidal antibiotics ka group hai; yeh bacteria ki cell wall banne ko rok kar infections ka ilaj karti hai. Ise Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein daryaft kiya.

book_ref.quote: used to treat various bacterial infections by inhibiting bacterial cell wall synthesis

blocks.prompt:
17 Why does penicillin kill bacteria but not harm animal cells?
(Penicillin bacteria ko kyun maarti hai magar janwaron ke cells ko nuqsan kyun nahin deti?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin peptidoglycan (murein) chains ki cross-linking rok kar cell wall banna band karti hai; kamzor wall phat jati hai (lysis). Janwaron ke cells mein cell wall nahin hoti, is liye un par asar nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: Penicillin target bacteria because animal cells lack the cell walls

blocks.prompt:
18 How do some bacteria become resistant to penicillin?
(Kuch bacteria penicillin ke khilaf muzahmat kaise paida karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch bacteria beta-lactamases jaise khaas enzymes bana kar penicillin se apna bachao karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some bacteria defend themselves by producing specific enzymes like beta-lactamases

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the uses, precautions and side effects of tetracycline.
(Tetracycline ke istemal, ehtiyat aur side effects likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Istemal: bacteriostatic oral antibiotic jo chlamydia aur syphilis jaise bacterial infections mein di jati hai.
Ehtiyat: doodh ki cheezon ya iron supplements ke saath na li jaye.
Side effects: matli, ulti, dast aur dhoop se hassasiyat.

book_ref.quote: Tetracycline antibiotic is derived from soil-dwelling bacteria

blocks.prompt:
20 How are fluoroquinolones related to quinine?
(Fluoroquinolones ka quinine se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones masnooi antibacterial mawad hain jo chloroquine ki tayyari ke byproduct ke tor par mile. Chloroquine quinine ki banawat badal kar bani masnooi dawa hai; quinine South American Cinchona darakht ki chhaal ka qudrati alkaloid hai.

book_ref.quote: Chloroquine is a synthetic drug derived from structural modification of quinine

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the side effects of fluoroquinolones.
(Fluoroquinolones ke side effects likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones ke kam magar sangeen side effects hain: tendon ka phatna, peripheral neuropathy, drug resistance aur dil ke masail.

book_ref.quote: They are also associated with significant, rare adverse side effects

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between the targets of fluoroquinolones in Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
(Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria mein fluoroquinolones ke targets ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono targets Type II topoisomerases hain.

book_ref.quote: it stops the separation of replicated DNA

rows: Bunyadi target: topoisomerase IV
Bunyadi target: DNA gyrase
Rukne se replicate hui DNA ka alag hona band
Rukne se replication mein DNA ka khulna band

blocks.prompt:
23 Why are fluoroquinolones called bactericidal?
(Fluoroquinolones ko bactericidal kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones DNA replication ke enzymes ko phansa kar aisa complex banati hain jis se DNA ki dono strands toot jati hain. Bacteria barh nahin pate aur mar jate hain, is liye yeh bacteria ko maarti hain.

book_ref.quote: This prevents the bacteria from multiplying and forces them to die

blocks.prompt:
24 Who discovered sulfonamides? Write their uses and side effects.
(Sulfonamides kis ne daryaft kiye? In ke istemal aur side effects likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides Gerhard Domagk ne 1932 mein daryaft kiye. Yeh zyada tar peshab ki naali aur jild ke infections mein (acne aur saans ke infections mein bhi) istemal hote hain. Side effects: jild par daane, matli, roshni se hassasiyat aur gurde ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: Sulfonamides are synthetic pharmaceutical compounds derived from sulfanilamide

blocks.prompt:
25 Why are sulfonamides selectively toxic to bacteria?
(Sulfonamides sirf bacteria ke liye zehreeli kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria ko zaroori vitamin folate khud shuru se banana parta hai, jab ke insaan use khurak se jazb kar lete hain. Sulfonamides folate ka banna rokti hain, is liye bacteria zaroori ghiza se mehroom hote hain aur insani cells mehfooz rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This allows the drug to starve the bacteria of vital nutrients

blocks.prompt:
26 How do sulfonamides act as bacteriostatic drugs? How can they become bactericidal?
(Sulfonamides bacteriostatic kaise hain? Yeh bactericidal kaise ban sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides bacteria ko foran nahin maarti balke un ki barhotri rokti hain, aur jism ka immune system unhein khatam karta hai. Trimethoprim jaise mawad ke saath mil kar inka asar zyada mazboot bactericidal (maarne wala) ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: allowing the body's immune system to destroy them

blocks.prompt:
27 What are antiviral drugs? Give examples of viruses they combat.
(Antiviral dawaiyan kya hain? Jin viruses ke khilaf yeh kaam karti hain un ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Antiviral dawaiyan viral infections ke ilaj ke liye hain; yeh jism mein viruses ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hain. Yeh hepatitis, influenza aur herpes jaise bohat se viruses ke khilaf kaam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: They prevent the growth and multiplication of viruses within the body

blocks.prompt:
28 What are retroviruses? Give an example.
(Retroviruses kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Retroviruses woh viruses hain jin ka genetic material RNA hai aur jo enzyme reverse transcriptase se apni copies banate hain. Misaal: HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus).

book_ref.quote: RNA as their genetic material

blocks.prompt:
29 What are monoclonal antibodies? Name the diseases for which they are used.
(Monoclonal antibodies kya hain? Woh kin bimariyon mein istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies laboratory mein bane molecules hain jo immune system ki pathogens se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain. Yeh khaas antigens ko nishana banati hain, is liye cancer, autoimmune bimariyon aur infectious bimariyon ke ilaj mein mufeed hain.

book_ref.quote: enhance the immune system’s ability to fight against pathogens

blocks.prompt:
30 How are monoclonal antibodies related to personalized medicine?
(Monoclonal antibodies ka personalized medicine se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies personalized medicine ka lazmi hissa hain: in se har mareez ke profile ke mutabiq ilaj mumkin hai. In ki design aur tayyari mein musalsal jiddat ilaj ko har mareez ki apni biology ke zyada munasib banati hai.

book_ref.quote: enabling tailored treatment approaches based on individual patient profiles

blocks.prompt:
31 How do modern antibody technologies speed up the response to infectious diseases and cancer?
(Jadeed antibody technologies infectious bimariyon aur cancer ka jawab tez kaise karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh technologies hazaron mumkina antibodies ko aik saath test karti hain. Is se tayyari ka waqt kam hota hai aur infectious bimariyon aur cancer jaise fori masail ka jald jawab mumkin hota hai.

book_ref.quote: reducing development timelines and enabling faster responses
